§ 01 · The Program

Real learners,
real decisions.

From designing a curriculum and handling difficult students, to measuring training ROI, launching a global online academy, and leading digital transformation in education, every scenario drops you into a genuine teaching or training situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Sixty-three foundations-focused scenarios and thirty-seven strategy-and-program-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real teaching judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation an educator or training professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across curriculum design, corporate training, digital learning, assessment, and education strategy.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound teaching judgment under real pressure.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Education Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping educators and training professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in education isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, education and training roles in English — Mr. Gad Education & Training Business is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the classroom moments you'll actually face.
